lines.text: Many learners say: My brother is the same age that me.
Better: My brother is the same age as me.
The second! He is the same age as me.

data.wrong: My brother is the same age that me.
data.right: My brother is the same age as me.

quiz.stem: He is the same age ___ me.

native.tip: Em português dizemos “da mesma idade que eu”; em inglês, depois de “the same age”, use “as”, não “that”.

en.tip: In Portuguese we say “da mesma idade que eu”; in English, after “the same age”, use “as”, not “that”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “My brother is the same age that me.” The right way is “My brother is the same age as me.” In Portuguese we say “da mesma idade que eu”; in English, after “the same age”, use “as”, not “that”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
